item.title: Is Trumpism the New McCarthyism?
item.description: In the 1950s, McCarthyism created a climate of fear and suspicion in American politics. The Times Opinion columnist Carlos Lozada and the historian Nicole Hemmer argue that, over 70 years later, McCarthyism is still a part of our politics today. Will Trumpism’s influence last as long?
